memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and also along the edge of the end curtain in the other set. Then make fifty bronze clasps and put them in the loops to fasten the tent together as a unit. As for the additional length of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over is to hang down at the rear of the tabernacle. The tent curtains will be a cubit longer on both sides; what is left will hang over the sides of the tabernacle so as to cover it." - Exodus 26:10-13 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God is remarkably specific. Fifty loops, fifty bronze clasps, a half curtain hanging at the rear, an extra cubit draping over each side. He accounts for the leftover fabric and tells them exactly where it should hang. Nothing is vague, and nothing is left to guesswork.

This level of detail tells us something about God's character. He is not careless or approximate. The God who numbered these curtains is the God who numbers the hairs on your head (Matt 10:30) and knows when a single sparrow falls. His attention to small things is not fussiness — it is the natural expression of a God who genuinely cares about what He is doing and who He is doing it for.

That should comfort us in the ordinary details of our own lives. The parts of your life that feel too small to bother God with are not beneath His notice. He is not only interested in your big decisions and dramatic crises. The God who specified where the extra cubit of fabric should hang cares about your daily routines, your minor worries, and the quiet corners of your life that no one else thinks about. Nothing about you is too small for His attention.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
Do I believe God cares about the small, ordinary details of my life?
What have I considered too minor to bring to God in prayer?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You attend to the smallest details with care. Thank You that nothing in my life is too small for Your notice. Help me bring even the little things to You. Amen.
